summary: English variant built on Manors that passively make food and wood. Strong ranged infantry and shock cavalry, with keeps that spawn Earl's Guards.

spikes.label: Manors and Yeomen
spikes.detail: Manors give passive income from Feudal, and Yeomen and Hobelars arrive early.
spikes.answer: Raid the Manors and villagers before the passive income stacks up.

spikes.label: Earl's Guard keeps
spikes.detail: Each keep gives three free Earl's Guards, and active keeps boost Earl's Guards and Demilancers.
spikes.answer: Don't fight near their keeps; bring siege.

Lancaster Castle, which now garrisons eight units

pairings.why: Ranged infantry with fast cavalry to clean up.
